inputs.name: netbird_version
inputs.description: NetBird client release to install from NetBird's repository, such as "0.82.0".

inputs.name: management_url
inputs.description: Management server the hosts join: NetBird's own, or your self-hosted server's address, such as "https://netbird.example.com:443".

inputs.name: join
inputs.description: Join the hosts to the network with setup_key. When false, the circuit installs NetBird and leaves the hosts as they are.

inputs.name: setup_key
inputs.description: NetBird setup key the hosts join with, such as A1B2C3D4-.... Required when join is true.

inputs.name: hostname
inputs.description: Name for the peer in the network. When null, NetBird uses the host's name. Meant for a single host: every host gets the same name. Used only when joining.

inputs.name: extra_args
inputs.description: More flags for netbird up, such as ["--disable-dns"]. Used only when joining.
